verdict.rationale: Typesense's own materials state that it combines typo-tolerant keyword search with direct vector, hybrid, and semantic search, and the GitHub README links a live semantic/hybrid search demo over 300K HN comments. Its docs also include a Semantic Search guide and GPU-accelerated embedding generation. missing for 10: in-depth docs showing how vector and keyword results are fused in a single query (fusion/weighting parameters), and independent or hands-on corroboration of hybrid search quality.
